title: Water and Wastewater Rate Schedule, effective July 1, 2026

extracted.part_ii_s1a: USD 5.35 per one hundred cubic feet; 100 cu ft approximately 748.052 gallons
extracted.part_ii_s1b: Minimum charge USD 0.49 per day per water meter
extracted.part_iii_s2: Wastewater charge is 159% of the charges for water supplied

establishes: A minimum charge for meter-billed customers of USD 0.49 per day for water service, plus wastewater at 159% of water charges, frozen since FY2017 and maintained for FY2027
That the minimum is per day and not by meter size
That it does not bind at the reference volume and binds below about 7.9 m3 a month
